paths.title: Bloodwrath Guardian
paths.description: Fight as a creature of primal fury, hunting down the enemies you have marked. While in a guardian form you move faster, and you can spend an action point to add your Wisdom to your attack rolls instead of taking an extra action. At higher levels, your melee attacks hit marked enemies harder. Your powers bring a heavy strike, a stance that marks anything starting or ending its turn beside you, and the form of the Primal Beast, with longer reach and a savage strike that leaves ongoing damage.

paths.title: Breach Warden
paths.description: Channel a rift of raw elemental power through your Elemental Breach, choosing acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder after each extended rest. Taking that damage or scoring a critical hit with a warden attack burns every enemy you have marked, and a successful action point attack does the same with your Constitution. Your powers teleport you after a burst of elemental force, charge your weapon and armor with the breach, and turn you into the Living Breach, drawing nearby enemies in and slowing them.

paths.title: Child of the North Wind
paths.description: Fight with a gale at your back, shoving enemies around and keeping them focused on you. An action point makes your hits either deal extra damage or knock foes prone, and dropping an enemy lets you slide everyone you have marked. At higher levels, your melee critical hits send marked enemies to the ground. Your powers push a target and mark its neighbors, conjure a protective whirlwind, and make you the Northern Whirlwind, with longer forced movement and a wider Nature's Wrath.

paths.title: Earth Shaker
paths.description: Hit foes where they are toughest, striking at Fortitude with growing precision. An action point spent in guardian form knocks prone each enemy you hit with a primal power, and eventually your at-will warden attacks can target Fortitude instead of AC. Your powers send thunder through obstacles and wrench burrowers from the ground, let you burrow swiftly to gain combat advantage, and transform you into a bulette that tunnels, toughens your Fortitude, and restores extra hit points when you spend a healing surge.

paths.title: Emerald Guardian
paths.description: Protect allies as fiercely as you hunt enemies, giving friends room to recover and reposition. An action point lets an adjacent ally shift, a successful save at the start of your turn lets a neighbor save as well, and your warden's fury power pushes enemies away while granting temporary hit points to an ally beside the target. Your powers drag a fleeing foe back for another blow, purge conjurations, zones and ongoing necrotic damage, and make you a Large life-giver who heals nearby allies each turn.

paths.title: Guardian of Two Worlds
paths.description: Hold the line between the wild and the mortal world, keeping marked enemies pinned beside you. In guardian form, an action point lets you repeat your form's attack, and marked enemies that start their turn next to you are slowed. The first time you hit a marked enemy on your turn, you can shake off a lingering effect. Your powers immobilize marked neighbors, extend your Font of Life to a friend, and let you become the Stag Knight, marking at range and punishing anyone who strikes an ally.

paths.title: Horned Champion
paths.description: Charge through the enemy ranks and press every advantage with the speed of a leaping stag. Opportunity attacks slow what they hit, action point attacks that miss can be rerolled, and your polymorph daily powers let you spend a healing surge for free. Your powers deliver a double strike that knocks foes prone, dash through hostile lines while punishing those who try to stop you, and bring the form of the Leaping Stag, with extra speed, enemies marked as you pass, and a charge that leaves a foe stunned.

paths.title: Icewrought Sentinel
paths.description: Wrap yourself in winter, freezing enemies in place while shrugging off the cold. An action point attack chills every enemy beside you or marked by you and sharpens your cold powers, you gain cold resistance, and your primal cold hits slide enemies away at higher levels. Your powers immobilize a target for a follow-up, encase an ally in ice that locks down whoever strikes them, and turn you into an icewrought sentinel with sturdier defenses, difficult terrain around you, and a blinding frozen strike.

paths.title: Radiant Serpent
paths.description: Move like a couatl, trailing light and slipping past anything between you and the fight. You resist radiant damage, shake off immobilizing effects more easily, and deal extra radiant damage after being burned by it. In guardian form, an action point makes you insubstantial and gives you flight, and your critical hits force the enemy to attack only you. Your powers coil light around a target that burns if it moves, share your healing surges with allies you pass, and grant the form of the Radiant Couatl.

paths.title: Scion of the All-Spirit
paths.description: Draw on the primal spirits of animal, plant, weather and element all at once. An action point makes you insubstantial and phasing for a turn, your critical hits ignore every resistance, and spending a healing surge helps a nearby ally save with a bonus equal to your Constitution. Your powers topple, deafen and mark enemies with a thunderous voice, teleport you to a foe you just marked, and become the All-Spirit, with resistance for you and adjacent allies and a teleporting strike that can dominate a foe.

paths.title: Storm Sentinel
paths.description: Crackle with lightning and ride the storm's endurance. Critical hits add lightning damage from your Strength, an action point attack lets you spend a healing surge afterward, and every surge you spend restores extra hit points from your Constitution. Your powers knock enemies flat with a thunderous smash, turn you insubstantial so you can fly to an enemy's side, and bring the form of Storm's Wrath, which marks adjacent enemies with lightning and zaps a nearby foe at the start of each turn.

paths.title: Tribal Champion
paths.description: Borrow the strength of your ancestors and the forms of every beast they revered. Your second wind lashes marked enemies with psychic damage, and an action point lets you assume any guardian form from your daily powers for a turn without spending its use, though you cannot use its attack. At higher levels, an ally's wounds sharpen your attacks. Your powers fell larger foes with a better critical range, add weapon dice to a form's attack, and make a marked enemy's attacks on others far weaker.
